article.title: Who was Wafaa Akila, the Gaza girl killed on her first day of school?
article.author: Editor
article.content: Nine-year-old Wafaa Akila was killed with her father in Gaza City after leaving school to buy supplies for the new year. The post Who was Wafaa Akila, the Gaza girl killed on her first day of school? appeared first on MR Online .
